verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is a terminal TUI agent, not a desktop app. It does present a diff for review before making permanent changes, and `/agents` opens a session command center, which offers some multi-session management. IDE connectors (VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains) exist, but the evidence never says they give visual diff review or side-by-side sessions. Missing for 10: a desktop app, graphical/visual diff review, side-by-side multi-session layout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
